set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols mpls label-protocol [param.explanation: Configures the tag distribution protocol for MPLS as LDP.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: Label distribution protocols, such as ldp.

set protocols mpls ldp router-id [parame.explanation: Configures the Router ID of the LDP protocol.

parameters.name: area-address
parameters.explanation: IS-IS regional address to identify IS-IS areas.

set protocols bgp group [parameter1].explanation: This command configures a BGP group named [parameter1], defining a set of BGP peers with shared session parameters.

neighbor [parameter2].explanation: Configure the neighbors of the BGP team.

address-family [parameter2].explanation: The command `address-family [parameter2]` specifies the protocol family (e.g., `inet` for IPv4 or `inet6` for IPv6) for routing or interface configuration in Junos.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

family inet vrf forwarding [parameter3].explanation: The command configures an interface to use the `inet` address family and forwards traffic through the VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) instance specified by `[parameter3]`.

parameters.name: vrf
parameters.explanation: VRF name, which specifies the instance of forwarding.

set policy-options policy-statement [par.explanation: This command fragment defines a routing policy named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing you to configure specific routing rules, actions, and conditions for traffic control.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

from route-filter [parameter3].explanation: The command `from route-filter [parameter3]` in Junos filters routes based on the specified prefix or range defined in `[parameter3]` for routing policy or configuration.

parameters.name: route-filter
parameters.explanation: Route filter, which matches a specific route.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure the action of the policy statement as accepted.
